purpose: TRAIN-only diagnostic of frozen common-control no-op growth against exact-time FEDS observations; no tuning, native PPO ranking or physical validation
case_selection: Exactly the16 preregistered TASK-040 cases, no outcome-based substitutions
ca: Unchanged TASK-040 full256 common-vegetation bridge, SpreadParams defaults, 2min, same seed_for(case,replicate) for0,1,2
control: No interventions, four decisions even after extinction, no tail
time_alignment: Exactly5 manifest naive local-solar AM/PM labels12h apart; convert using existing feds_overpass_utc and weather_sample_location.longitude; match4 segment starts/ends within1ms; no naive-label-as-UTC
observation_loading: After predictions frozen; checksum-verified local2018/2019 archives only; one full annual scan per year, collect only selected exact fireID/time geometries, never2023/2024
rasterization: Existing receipt CRS/affine/full256; unary_union full exact-time parts, all_touched=True; require t0 mask identical to imported burn_scar; initial exclusion domain scar|front
coverage: Retain all16 records and explicit missing/invalid geometries; do not impute or silently repair. Report full vector area outside grid, lost initial/intermediate observed cells, edge contact and observed growth on nonfuel. Primary complete-five-state cases; always also report fully grid-covered subset, no case replacement.
primary_endpoint: 48h raw exact-time FEDS growth; mean new-area IoU on common complete cases with observed_new_cells>0, and mean absolute new-area error ha on all common complete cases; CA spread0 primary
secondary: All3 preregistered CA spread replicates, average scalar metrics within case before case aggregation, never threshold a mean mask or select best seed
12/24/36h trajectories, time-pooled growth IoU then equal case weighting
Cumulative envelope of all5 observed masks as explicit observation-nonmonotonicity sensitivity, not replacement of primary
Fully covered subset and existing ADR030 observed48h_area>=1.10*initial_area subgroup, descriptive
Signed/absolute new-area errors, area ratio only observed growth>0; no-growth false growth separately
Persistence and unchanged fixed downwind ellipse protocol as references, not calibration targets
zero_rules: IoU undefined only empty union; primary IoU uses same observed-positive case IDs for all methods; area ratio undefined if observed_new_cells=0; report counts and no-growth false positives without epsilon

uncertainty.method: paired case bootstrap,10000 draws seed0; equal case weights; CA replicas averaged inside case; endpoint IoU and absolute-area-error differences CA minus SF; descriptive, no refit, no multiplicity correction

verification: Test metrics/time/split/missing coverage before implementation; replay final SF/CA0 masks must equal TASK040 archives; CA1/2 final counts must match TASK040, predictions cumulative and full horizon; no scoring until both backends finished

compute.estimate: 3–6min no-op replays plus tests; no training

stop_conditions: Non-TRAIN selection before any file opens
Initial raster or archived final replay mismatch
